summary: Iteration 2 — full regression after product swap to ম্যাজিক টিস্যু + nooranishop-style colorful light landing redesign. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (test data updated 1/2/3-pcs → 10/20-pcs, delivery 110→120, title check). Frontend landing: title/subtitle render, package switch (Starter 490 / Premier 900) recomputes total correctly (550, 960, 1040 with qty=2, 610 for outside-Dhaka), qty +/- works, area chips toggle, phone & address validation shows Bengali toast, valid order submits and shows success toast, FAQ accordion opens. Admin: wrong-password rejected, login OK, stats show new order, status update (pending→confirmed) saves, delete removes row, product editor save succeeds (toast 'প্রোডাক্ট আপডেট হয়েছে'), logout OK.

issues: Admin pages still use DARK theme (black bg, red lock icon, dim text) while public Landing is now the colorful light nooranishop theme. Visually inconsistent. Intentional per review-request ('AdminLogin/Dashboard unchanged'), so flagged only as minor copy/design feedback.
Footer still reads 'Smart Pen Knife Admin' — leftover branding from previous product. Should be 'ম্যাজিক টিস্যু Admin' or generic 'Admin Panel'.

Trust-row uses Bangla labels with low contrast in some pastel cards (e.g., orange-50 / orange-700 'ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি' is fine, but the purple-50 lock card text is borderline at small sizes). Optional polish.

action_items: Optional: rebrand admin login footer text 'Smart Pen Knife Admin' → 'ম্যাজিক টিস্যু Admin'.
Optional: apply the new light palette (or at least an updated header/logo) to AdminLogin & AdminDashboard for brand consistency.
Optional: consider centering 'shop-heading' boxes more tightly on small screens — they look great on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
ProductUpdate.offer_end_iso cannot be cleared to None (server filters None values before $set). Use model_fields_set or a sentinel if clearing is needed.
Landing.jsx is ~500 lines; still maintainable but consider extracting OrderForm and PackagesSection into separate components for readability/test isolation.
Frontend uses hard-coded Bengali toast strings inline — fine for single-language site but a small i18n dict would help future maintenance.

Trust-badge colors are mostly Tailwind-50 backgrounds with -700 text — passes contrast, but rely on Tailwind defaults; verify in production build with purgeCSS that the dynamic classNames in trust array aren't purged (they are static strings here, so OK).
No rate-limit on /api/admin/login — single-admin password-only by design; adding a small sleep on wrong password would deter brute force.
